approach: Replicate the strongest measured public implementation: jiayaoqijia YQ, unchanged. Eleven slots maintain bid/ask, timestamp, fair-price estimate, volatility, arrival rate, size, toxicity, activity, direction and per-step count. Reconstruct fee-band-implied price using the previous fee; blend first-in-step observations at 26% and later observations at 5%, behind a sigma-dependent outlier gate. Decay signals on elapsed steps. Fees combine a flow/volatility base, nonlinear toxicity and activity widening, directional pressure, asymmetric stale-price protection/discount, trade-aligned boosts, and tail compression. There is no direct fair-price observation or explicit arb label; these are estimators. Reject both Dipankar candidates on paired training results and freeze YQ before holdout evaluation.
